comparisons.reason: Item 0 requires a comment to quote OP text AND dispute/refute the quoted material. Item 1 measures quotation presence alone and explicitly says refutation is not required. Per the quotation vs. endorsement/challenge rule, the narrower quote-and-refute subtype is not the same as quote presence. The null rules also differ: item 0 gives null if the OP text needed to verify the quote is missing, while item 1 gives null only if both title and argument are missing and keeps a positive match as 1.
